name: HIV Care and Treatment Audit Tool
description: Comprehensive HIV care and treatment audit tool with quality indicators across clinical, pharmacy, lab, and adherence domains

config.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT pp.patient_id
FROM patient_program pp
         INNER JOIN program p ON pp.program_id = p.program_id
WHERE p.uuid = '18c6d4aa-0a36-11e7-8dbb-507b9dc4c741'
  AND pp.date_enrolled <= :endDate
  AND (pp.date_completed IS NULL OR pp.date_completed >= :startDate)
  AND pp.voided = 0

SELECT DISTINCT pp.patient_id
FROM patient_program pp
         INNER JOIN program p ON pp.program_id = p.program_id
WHERE p.uuid = '18c6d4aa-0a36-11e7-8dbb-507b9dc4c741'
  AND pp.date_enrolled <= :endDate
  AND (pp.date_completed IS NULL OR pp.date_completed >= :startDate)
  AND pp.voided = 0

SELECT DATE(pp.date_enrolled) FROM patient_program pp INNER JOIN program p ON pp.program_id = p.program_id WHERE p.uuid = 'ba882722-3d9f-4e58-a830-6d636003d38d' AND pp.patient_id = :patientId AND pp.voided = 0 ORDER BY pp.date_enrolled ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, (SELECT pp.date_enrolled FROM patient_program pp INNER JOIN program p ON pp.program_id = p.program_id WHERE p.uuid = 'ba882722-3d9f-4e58-a830-6d636003d38d' AND pp.patient_id = :patientId AND pp.voided = 0 ORDER BY pp.date_enrolled ASC LIMIT 1), :endDate)

SELECT (SELECT cn.name FROM concept_name cn WHERE cn.concept_id = o.value_coded AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AND cn.voided = 0) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid IN ('e5aaaa9a-2224-42c7-b6d3-efd6a56064da', '162942AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA')) AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT cn.name FROM concept_name cn WHERE cn.concept_id = o.value_coded AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AND cn.voided = 0) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 1650 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT cn.name FROM concept_name cn WHERE cn.concept_id = o.value_coded AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AND cn.voided = 0) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 1651 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime <= (SELECT pp.date_enrolled FROM patient_program pp INNER JOIN program p ON pp.program_id = p.program_id WHERE p.uuid = 'ba882722-3d9f-4e58-a830-6d636003d38d' AND pp.patient_id = :patientId AND pp.voided = 0 ORDER BY pp.date_enrolled ASC LIMIT 1) AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT cn.name FROM concept_name cn WHERE cn.concept_id = o.value_coded AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AND cn.voided = 0) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 1651 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT o.value_numeric FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 5497 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime <= (SELECT pp.date_enrolled FROM patient_program pp INNER JOIN program p ON pp.program_id = p.program_id WHERE p.uuid = 'ba882722-3d9f-4e58-a830-6d636003d38d' AND pp.patient_id = :patientId AND pp.voided = 0 ORDER BY pp.date_enrolled ASC LIMIT 1) AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE(o.obs_datetime) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 5497 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime <= (SELECT pp.date_enrolled FROM patient_program pp INNER JOIN program p ON pp.program_id = p.program_id WHERE p.uuid = 'ba882722-3d9f-4e58-a830-6d636003d38d' AND pp.patient_id = :patientId AND pp.voided = 0 ORDER BY pp.date_enrolled ASC LIMIT 1) AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT o.value_numeric FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 5497 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DATE(o.obs_datetime) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 5497 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT o.value_numeric FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 856 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime <= (SELECT pp.date_enrolled FROM patient_program pp INNER JOIN program p ON pp.program_id = p.program_id WHERE p.uuid = 'ba882722-3d9f-4e58-a830-6d636003d38d' AND pp.patient_id = :patientId AND pp.voided = 0 ORDER BY pp.date_enrolled ASC LIMIT 1) AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE(o.obs_datetime) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 856 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime <= (SELECT pp.date_enrolled FROM patient_program pp INNER JOIN program p ON pp.program_id = p.program_id WHERE p.uuid = 'ba882722-3d9f-4e58-a830-6d636003d38d' AND pp.patient_id = :patientId AND pp.voided = 0 ORDER BY pp.date_enrolled ASC LIMIT 1) AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT o.value_numeric FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 856 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DATE(o.obs_datetime) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 856 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT o.value_numeric FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 856 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1) < 1000 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 1652 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

SELECT (SELECT cn.name FROM concept_name cn WHERE cn.concept_id = o.value_coded AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AND cn.voided = 0) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 1652 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 1654 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0) THEN 'On TPT' ELSE 'Not on TPT' END
SELECT DATE(o.obs_datetime) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 1654 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 1653 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0) THEN 'On CPT' ELSE 'Not on CPT' END

SELECT (SELECT cn.name FROM concept_name cn WHERE cn.concept_id = o.value_coded AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AND cn.voided = 0) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 162920 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT cn.name FROM concept_name cn WHERE cn.concept_id = o.value_coded AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AND cn.voided = 0) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 162921 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT cn.name FROM concept_name cn WHERE cn.concept_id = o.value_coded AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AND cn.voided = 0) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 164960 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DATE(o.value_datetime) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 164960 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN o.value_coded IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '90156') THEN 'Good' WHEN o.value_coded IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '90157') THEN 'Fair' WHEN o.value_coded IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid = '90158') THEN 'Poor' ELSE 'Unknown' END FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 90221 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE(e.encounter_datetime) FROM encounter e WHERE e.encounter_type = (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid = '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f') AND e.patient_id = :patientId AND e.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND e.voided = 0 ORDER BY e.encounter_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DATEDIFF(:endDate, (SELECT DATE(e.encounter_datetime) FROM encounter e WHERE e.encounter_type = (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid = '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f') AND e.patient_id = :patientId AND e.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND e.voided = 0 ORDER BY e.encounter_datetime DESC LIMIT 1))

SELECT DATE(e.encounter_datetime) FROM encounter e WHERE e.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid IN ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')) AND e.patient_id = :patientId AND e.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND e.voided = 0 ORDER BY e.encounter_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE(o.value_datetime) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 5096 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.value_datetime >= :startDate AND o.value_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.value_datetime ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.value_datetime) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 5096 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.value_datetime >= DATE_SUB(:startDate, INTERVAL 3 MONTH) AND o.value_datetime < :startDate AND o.voided = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM encounter e WHERE e.patient_id = o.person_id AND e.encounter_datetime BETWEEN o.value_datetime AND DATE_ADD(o.value_datetime, INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND e.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid IN ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')) AND e.voided = 0)

SELECT CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(:endDate, (SELECT MAX(e.encounter_datetime) FROM encounter e WHERE e.encounter_type IN (SELECT encounter_type_id FROM encounter_type WHERE uuid IN ('8d5b27bc-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f', '8d5b2be0-c2cc-11de-8d13-0010c6dffd0f')) AND e.patient_id = :patientId AND e.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND e.voided = 0)) > 90 THEN 'Lost' ELSE 'Active' END

SELECT (SELECT cn.name FROM concept_name cn WHERE cn.concept_id = o.value_coded AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AND cn.voided = 0) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 99769 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT (SELECT cn.name FROM concept_name cn WHERE cn.concept_id = o.value_coded AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' AND cn.voided = 0) FROM obs o WHERE o.concept_id = 162922 AND o.person_id = :patientId AND o.obs_datetime >= :startDate AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1
